const t=$json.normalized_lower;
const checks=[
['security_suspicion',/(ignore|jib|a3tini|show).{0,80}(system|prompt|instruction|token|secret|password|api key)|bypass.{0,40}(security|validator|rule)|give me (the )?(system|developer) prompt/i],
['payment_dispute',/(charge|charged|debit|fraud|unauthori|double).{0,50}(payment|paiement|carte)|litige|اعتراض.*دفع/],
['human_request',/(human|agent|support humain|parler.*personne|نحب.*موظف)/i],
['complaint',/(complain|complaint|réclamation|reclamat|probl[eè]me|مشكل|غاضب)/i],
['return_exchange',/(return|exchange|échange|retour|rembourse|remboursement|بدل|ترجيع)/i],
['order_status',/(where|win|ou|status|statut|suivi|track|commande).{0,40}(order|commande)|فين.*commande|وين.*commande/i],
['checkout_confirm',/(confirm|confirme|confirmer|أكد|اكّد).{0,30}(commande|order|checkout)|نأكد.*طلب/i],
['checkout_start',/(checkout|passer.*commande|finaliser|nekammel.*checkout|نكمّل.*الطلب)/i],
['cart_clear',/(clear|empty|vider|faragh|faraghli|فرّغ).{0,30}(cart|panier|السلة)|فرغ.*السلة/i],
['cart_remove',/(remove|delete|na7i|enl[eè]ve|supprime|نحي|احذف).{0,30}(cart|panier|item|produit|السلة)/i],
['cart_update',/(change|update|badal|baddel|modifier|بدّل|غير).{0,40}(size|taille|qty|quant|variant|لون|couleur|taille|المقاس)/i],
['cart_view',/(show|view|see|warini|affiche|voir).{0,30}(cart|panier|السلة)|شنوة.*في.*السلة/i],
['cart_add',/(add|ajoute|zid|zidh|حط|زيد).{0,60}(cart|panier|السلة)|zidhali.*panier|حط.*السلة/i],
['promotion',/(promo|promotion|discount|réduction|offer|عرض|تخفيض|code promo)/i],
['pricing',/(price|prix|combien|bgadech|b9adech|souma|ثمن|سعر|قداش)/i],
['availability',/(available|disponible|mawjoud|mawjouda|stock|taille).{0,50}(size|taille|42|43|44|produit|article)|متوفر|موجود/i],
['shipping',/(shipping|livraison|delivery|وصل|توصيل|d[eé]lai)/i],
['payment',/(payment|paiement|cash|carte|الدفع|خلاص)/i],
['comparison',/(compare|comparison|versus|vs|better|diff[eé]rent|بين.*و|شنو.*خير)/i],
['product_question',/(what|how|material|mati[eè]re|care|entretien|كيفاش|شنية|شنو.*مادة)/i],
['product_discovery',/(new|nouveau|جديد|jdid|catalog|catalogue|products|produits|شنوة.*عندكم|chnowa.*dnkom|nheb.*produit|نحب.*منتج)/i],
['off_topic',/(weather|football|politics|recipe|برشا.*حاجات)/i]
];
let matches=[];
for (const [intent,re] of checks) if(re.test(t)) matches.push(intent);
const priority=['security_suspicion','payment_dispute','human_request','complaint','return_exchange','order_status','checkout_confirm','checkout_start','cart_clear','cart_remove','cart_update','cart_view','cart_add','promotion','pricing','availability','shipping','payment','comparison','product_question','product_discovery','off_topic'];
let intent=priority.find(x=>matches.includes(x))||'clarification';
let confidence=intent==='clarification'?0.2:(matches.length===1?0.92:0.78);
return [{json:{...$json,candidate_intent:intent,candidate_matches:matches,confidence}}];
